tools.name: check_legal_risks
tools.description: Check a planned or new feature for legal risks. Call this whenever the user plans or builds a feature for a product used in Sri Lanka, or made by a Sri Lankan company or person, even if they didn't ask about law. If the user hasn't said where the users or company are, ask them first; never guess the

tools.name: get_fact_questions
tools.description: List the facts check_legal_risks understands, grouped, each with the question it answers. Call once before check_legal_risks.

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: Get one rule in full, including the exact quote from the law and its official source link. Use it to show proof for a warning.

tools.name: get_checklist
tools.description: Get a law checklist for the product, for example the PDPA 2027 checklist: the rules of that law that apply to these facts, each with what to look for in the code (look_for) or ask the user (ask). Use it when the user asks whether their project is ready for the PDPA. Send country codes and facts only
